title: Federal Student Aid Data Center (student loan portfolio, Title IV volume by school)
agency: U.S. Department of Education, Office of Federal Student Aid
questions: total federal student loan debt outstanding, latest quarter
how many borrowers are in default or forbearance on Direct Loans
outstanding student loans by repayment plan (SAVE, IBR, PAYE)
student loan balance and borrowers by state
Pell Grant disbursements at a college in the latest award year
Direct Loan volume by school and loan type
student debt held by borrowers aged 62 and older

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (each is an .xls workbook on studentaid.gov), save it under the name shown and upload it. Without the links: open the FSA Data Center (https://studentaid.gov/data-center), Student Aid Data > Federal Student Loan Portfolio (https://studentaid.gov/data-center/student/portfolio) or Title IV Program Volume (https://studentaid.gov/data-center/student/title-iv), download the report's .xls and upload it, saying which report it is. Reading an .xls needs the Python package xlrd; without it, open the workbook in a spreadsheet program and save the sheet as CSV (keep the title rows) before uploading.

cache.why: Portfolio reports are refreshed quarterly in place and volume files are revised for seven quarters; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: Federal Student Aid Data Center reports are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); they are aggregates with no personal data.

citation: U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid, {dataset}, FSA Data Center (studentaid.gov/data-center), retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which loans: all federal student loans (Direct Loans + FFEL + Perkins, the Portfolio Summary total), Direct Loans only, or the federally managed portfolio (Direct Loans + ED-held FFEL)? Default: the total, with Direct Loans shown separately.
Dollars or borrowers? Recipient counts cannot be added across programs or statuses (a recipient can hold several loan types); use the Total's unduplicated recipients for the count of people.
Award year (July-June, for loan and grant volume by school) or federal fiscal year (October-September, for the portfolio)? Default: the latest complete one of whichever the report uses.
